pressure_note: pi = initial CO2 pressure (atm) in the dry vessel before water injection; lambda obtained from the slope of y (water injected) vs 1/pc over the two-phase region, with pc = P - pw (P total, pw saturated water vapour pressure), so each value covers a range of pc of the order of pi.

P.what: initial CO2 pressure; not the equilibrium CO2 partial pressure

value.what: Ostwald coefficient lambda = (g CO2/cc liquid)/(g CO2/cc vapour) at the experimental CO2 pressures (not the limiting lambda0); liquid and vapour water densities interpolated from Tables 3 and 4 (pure-water densities below 250 C)

conversion_needs: Printed transposed (T, pi, lambda as rows; two printed row-blocks of 10 and 8 columns); written one CSV row per printed column, first block then second.
Conversion of lambda to mole fraction needs CO2 vapour density at T and pc (authors used pure-CO2 z from Sweigert et al.) and the liquid water density; pc itself is not printed.
notes: pvt (volumetric) method, Section 4. Authors prefer the liquid-analysis values of Table 2; the two methods differ by at most 0.05 in lambda at 300 C. 244 C lambda printed '0 31' with a faint decimal point, read 0.31.
